title: This beginner Meta Ads mistake is RUINING your results
description: This beginner Meta Ads mistake is RUINING your results
transcript: If you don't understand the learning phase, you could be killing your meta ads without realizing it. The learning phase occurs after you create a new ad set or make significant adjustments to an ad set. And during the learning phase, meta is going to test a lot of different variables to try and work out how to get you more of the results you've told meta that you want. So they're gonna test which people to put ads in front of, which placement options work best, how many ad impressions people need in a certain period of time, lots of different variables. Now, if you're constantly making adjustments to your ad sets, to your ads within those ad sets, you're never going to get out of the learning phase. It can last anything from a few hours to about a week. And you need to get out of the learning phase in order for meta to be able to optimize your ad sets and your campaigns properly. See, a lot of beginners, they can't leave their ads and their ad campaigns alone. They constantly re-enter the learning phase and it hurts their performance.
